blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Life & Annuities — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the life & annuities operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

Life books run on decades-long promises: underwriting quality at issue, servicing responsiveness across 30-year relationships, and actuarial integrity across regime changes (IFRS 17/LDTI). The machinery deciding those outcomes is data and document heavy — ideal ground for governed automation.

items: Underwriting health data and beneficiary PII create long-retention sensitive estates; PQ exposure deep.
APS records, paramedical data and financial underwriting arrive as documents; assembly consumes days per case.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, Identity & Access Modernization, Identity & Access Modernization from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Underwriting evidence assembly, Policy servicing transactions, Claims/beneficiary processing) on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses. Governance inherits the sector frame — IFRS 17 / LDTI among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
classification-aware controls for health/PII archives (sensitive estate governed)
